apiKey.keyFor: Sync needs the user's own WebDAV password or a Google Drive, Dropbox or pCloud sign-in; no provider is set by default

evidence.quote: Synchronize Zotero metadata, attachments, notes, and PDF annotations with WebDAV or supported cloud providers.
Sync your Zotero library to cloud storage providers

checkNote: README: "synchronizes your Zotero library with your own WebDAV server or a supported cloud account". Default pref("extensions.zotcloud.provider", "") is empty and the code stores a WebDAV password and OAuth client secrets, so sync cannot run until the user supplies their own credentials or sign-in. No AI features.
